parallel_token_swapping.limitation: The single central cut supports the phase invariant; adjacent cuts in longer backbones can be disturbed and no identity-preserving repair bound was derived.
It represents original-path crossings only; legal schedules may require extra traversal pairs and occupancy-dependent shoves.
The factor 4h^2-1 depends on the number h of non-leaf vertices and does not yield a uniform arbitrary-tree factor.

simple_treewidth_profiles.limitation: A constant-size guard is itself a landmark set; the LCA guard family has O(k) members, so the local assertion is not a narrower bridge.
Deleting host edges changes measured distances; e.g. P4 as a subgraph of K4 has endpoint distances 0,1,2,3 rather than the clique pattern.

mechanisms.name: LCA-closure separator guards
mechanisms.theorem_reconstructed: A width-t tree decomposition yields at most 4|A| guards of size at most 2(t+1), each separating its assigned vertex from every landmark by hitting all relevant paths.
mechanisms.invariant: Bounded separator coverage of paths in the measured graph.
critical_hypotheses: valid tree decomposition of the measured graph
LCA closure of topmost landmark bags
mechanisms.limitation: Separator coverage alone does not bound the number of distance vectors to a guard.

mechanisms.name: Outerplanar BFS-layer monotone partitions
mechanisms.invariant: On each root-BFS layer, distance to a fixed landmark is monotone away from a layer minimum along either side of a common outer-face circular order.
mechanisms.limitation: Branching decomposition regions and edge deletions do not supply the needed measured-graph order.

mechanisms.name: Linear-matroid representative families
mechanisms.theorem_reconstructed: For independent p-sets in a represented matroid of rank p+q, a q-representative subfamily of size at most binom(p+q,p) preserves feasible extensions; weighted variants preserve an optimum representative.
mechanisms.invariant: Exterior-product vectors and complementary determinant pairing preserve every extension-feasibility query.
critical_hypotheses: extension predicate encoded by determinant pairing
mechanisms.limitation: Metric profiles combine through min-plus completions; no bounded-dimensional linear representation preserving all such completions was found.

candidate_tests.reason: The proposed O(r^3) bound for every source-standard constant-size guard is equivalent up to constants to the full simple-treewidth-3 O(r^3 k) conjecture.
No linear extension encoding of all relevant min-plus completions was established; merely applying representative-family terminology would not preserve the required semantics.
No canonical order on partial-graph BFS layers with a proved bounded-alternation property was identified. No universal counterexample to all possible orders is claimed.
Per-edge detour accounting does not construct realizable swaps, matching rounds, or a bounded precedence depth.

publication_potential: low_as_a_standalone_contribution; this is a bounded methodology and prior-art audit
unresolved_obligations: Find a genuinely narrower simple-treewidth-3 corridor invariant that survives edge deletion and is not equivalent to the full profile conjecture.
For metric representative compression, define and prove a bounded representation preserving every relevant min-plus completion query, or establish a precise obstruction.
For caterpillar routing, construct identity-realizable detours with both matching-load and precedence-depth bounds, or prove a schedule-independent asymptotic lower bound.
